# Oversized images

Every picture below is larger than any page. Each one is scaled to the column and to 85 percent of the page height, and moves whole to the next page when it does not fit.

Text that fills the page so that a picture which does not fit the rest of it has to move to the next page, leaving the space below this paragraph empty, as the pagination rule for atomic blocks says.
